title: Cartwise Shopper Batches Long-Distance Order Supplement Schedule
content:
The long-distance order supplement of Cartwise Shopper Batches is added to the long-distance bonus for the additional orders a batch was paid for.

**Counting the additional orders.** The count is the batch's posted per-order pay divided by the batch type's pay per additional order, rounded to a whole number. Where no per-order pay is posted on the batch, the count is zero.

**Supplement.**

| Additional orders counted | Supplement |
|---|---|
| Two or more | 0.40 per additional order |
| Exactly one | 0.30 per additional order |
| Zero | Nothing |

**Pay per additional order by batch type.** 3.00 for the Double Delivery Batch and the Triple Delivery Batch; 0.00 for the Shop-Only Batch, Express 30 Batch, Single Delivery Batch and Stock-Up Batch, which post no per-order pay.

## Worked figures (hypothetical postings)

| Batch type | Per-order pay posted | Count | Supplement |
|---|---|---|---|
| Triple Delivery Batch | 6.00 | 6.00 divided by 3.00 is 2 | 2 multiplied by 0.40 is 0.80 |
| Double Delivery Batch | 3.00 | 3.00 divided by 3.00 is 1 | 1 multiplied by 0.30 is 0.30 |
| Single Delivery Batch | none | 0 | Nothing |

The count follows what was posted as per-order pay on the batch, not the orders listed on the offer: a Triple Delivery Batch on which only 3.00 of per-order pay stands counts one additional order and receives 0.30.
